notes: C5 (explaining how thermal expansion and transition volume changes enter the elastic simulations) is marked partly via P8/P9, which critique the strain reference and fixed/omitted thermoelastic terms. C6 is marked partly via P1, which asks how the white lines in Fig. 3b-f are obtained but does not ask for a fuller physical guide to reading them. C8 is marked partly via P10/P15/P21, which demand explicit D_FM values and mapping across scenarios. C9 is marked partly via P3/P4/P19, which ask for unpumped reference profiles and pre-time-zero qz stability along the XFEL train (motivated by burst-mode heating/damage and filtering rather than probe-induced shifts, but requiring the same control data). C11 is marked partly via P27, which critiques overemphasis of the 30 nm estimate in the abstract/main text without specifically proposing moving it to the Supplementary.
